propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md incorrectly document that the --force[=<reason>] override on transition and claim operations is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP
The 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinded the CLI-only policy; force is now allowed on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) and audited by the absence of a signed attestation
The shipped MCP surface and _mcp_writes.py docstrings already expose reason-bearing force parameter on transition_ticket and claim_ticket with correct documentation
Documentation must be rewritten to state that force is available on all surfaces and that CI certification-checks enforce attestation requirements, not MCP withholding
Out-of-scope CLI-only statements about other bypass families (--allow-secret-pattern, bridge setup wizard) must remain unchanged
